description: Ministry of Housing, Construction & Cultural Affairs - The Construction Industry Development (Appeal Procedure) Regulations - 2019
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Construction Industry Development Act, No. 33 of 2014. It establishes legal procedures for appeals against decisions of the Construction Industry Development Authority, including filing requirements, documentation, fees, and timelines. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
